correctness.rationale: The iff characterization is proved by a positive-pattern upper bound, a forced-five-edge-path negative trace, and all 64 explicit four-edge-type trace witnesses under S6 symmetry. Standard matching alternation identifies exactly 105 concepts. Two independently written programs enumerate faces and verify the f-vector (1,15,105,375,675), four facet orbit sizes 45,360,180,90, and exact reduced mod-two boundary ranks (1,14,91,284) giving sole Betti_3=391. Source files are included and were run from current paths.

originality.rationale: The target is the complete Boolean trace classification of the 105 exact symmetric differences of distinct perfect matchings of K6, including 675 graph-typed maximal four-edge supports and reduced mod-two homology. The first-public 2018 Cambie–Girão–Kang work gives general extremal VC estimates for symmetric-difference systems but not this finite structure. The closest indexed Hamiltonian-cycle shattering work concerns only the 60 six-cycle concepts; inclusion of the 45 four-cycle concepts changes the set system, and neither its VC-dimension statement nor any generic VC bound determines the claimed complete polynomial or homology. Searches for aliases, shape classification and specific coefficients did not find coverage; historical priority remains unverified beyond these sources.

value.rationale: The two-fold symmetric difference of one-factors is a canonical alternating-cycle family, naturally motivated by the 2018 work on VC properties of symmetric differences. K6 is the first complete even-order graph whose nonzero differences can have both length four and length six; the invariant records their interaction. A sharp forbidden-support criterion, complete four-orbit facet classification, and nontrivial rank-391 top homology answer concrete natural questions not determined by concept count, cycle count or VC dimension alone. No larger-order or downstream result is presumed.
